lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed in the mid-dorsal region where the 7th and 8th stripes (from the anterior) converge toward the top of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several line segments on the lower mid-flank appear as abbreviated dashes or dots that terminate before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower haunch align to form a semi-connected diagonal geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings including a distinct spot on the bridge of the nose and white patches around the eye and muzzle area.
